cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: Sikafloor®-94 may only be used by experienced professionals.
s: Primer for concrete surfaces with Sikafloor resin systems.
Binder resin for Epoxy mortar Sub-fill mortar screeds.
Binder for epoxy Coving mixes.
Flow and scratch coat layering prior to Sikafloor systems.
